text:
liam: quick sync  we keep losing clarity on who owns marketplace-sourced accounts when SIs retroactively engage. proposing a "claim + announce" pattern to lock ownership and make joint announcement decisions explicit.
neha: like a two-step: 1) SI claims within window, 2) SI files announce intent (logo/press) within X days or lose announcement rights?
carol: yes. concrete: claim window = 10 days for mid-market, 21 for enterprise (>1M ARR). announce-intent window = 7 days after claim. if SI misses announce-intent -> no co-marketing rights.
ryan: operationally that helps marketing planning. also add a mandatory "handoff note" when claiming: 1-line deal summary + contact + any compliance or HW constraints. block claims without it.
liam: add a short triage matrix for ownership:\n```\n- SI_has_MSR (master reseller) OR signed_imp_clause -> SI_primary\n- SI_intro + proof (email/calendar) within 30d -> SI_primary\n- SI_intro but no proof -> joint-touch for claim_window then redwood_owner\n- marketplace_source with no SI_activity -> redwood_owner\n```\nneha: what counts as proof? calendar invite with buyer + SI OR an SI-sent intro email that references opportunity id. nothing else.
carol: exceptions: hardware integrators delivering appliances get joint ownership until provisioning complete. also for SI-customized models or on-prem appliances, SI retains implementation credit for 18 months post-close.
ryan: crediting rule proposal: origin credit = partner_credit field in CRM. defaults: SI_origin_credit=100% for 12 months if SI-led POC; if joint POC -> split 50/50 unless activity points >60% for one side.
liam: dispute flow: SI_claim_dispute opened -> 24h triage by partnerships; unresolved 48h -> sales ops; unresolved 96h -> GTM exec arbitration. require one-sentence justification at each escalation.
neha: add automation: ops-bot can stamp claim_expires and send reminders T-3d, T-1d, and expire at 00:00 PT on expiry day. ops-bot: noted, can implement webhook + scheduled job.
ops-bot: system note: "Will create ticket in #si-intake with tags: claim_window, announce_deadline, partner_credit" (reaction :gear:)
carol: marketing/announce checklist (short): logos cleared, joint one-liner, agreed launch date, press contact, any regulatory approvals. require SI to fill this within announce-intent window.
ryan: edge cases: multiple SIs on same account -> require primary designation in CRM. subcontracted SIs must be listed in partner_chain field; primary retains claim unless they explicitly transfer it.
neha: process for retroactive claims (SI engages after redwood has started motion): SI must provide proof of prior relationship or value-add. partnerships triages retro claims with 3 business day review.
liam: ready-to-ship items: 1) 1-page claim + announce playbook, 2) CRM fields (si_primary, claim_expires, announce_deadline, partner_credit_pct, partner_chain), 3) ops webhook prototype. owners: neha -> playbook, carol -> marketing checklist, ryan -> CRM changes, ops-bot -> webhook prototype.
neha: target publish EOD Tuesday. carol: will draft example announcement email and logo checklist. ryan: will add partner_credit_pct as read-only after close and validation on claims.
ops-bot: reminder set: "review claim+announce playbook" on 2025-09-08 11:00 PT.
liam: one more: require a one-sentence "value statement" in the claim handoff: what the SI will own or enable (e.g., implementation/edge appliance/integration). helps credit disputes later.
neha: perfect. i'll include sample templates in the playbook. launching a 15m walkthrough with SDRs + SI leads next week.
carol: thanks all  will post confluence link when drafts are ready.
ryan: :+1:
